messages.subject: Parallel Growth Curve Model
parts:
Hi,

I'm new to Lavaan and R in general.  I would like to conduct a parallel growth curve model between two variables over three time points with covariates. Below is a basic linear growth curve model; how would I add variable "z" measured over the same three time points with the same covariates.  Specifically, I would like to show the extent to which changes in x and z are correlated over time.  Thanks in advance for any suggestions.  Best, Chris

#Latent
i =~ x1 + x2 +x3
s =~ 1*x1 + 2*x2 + 3*x2

#Regression
i ~ age + education
s ~ age + education

#Covariance
i ~ s

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Parallel Growth Curve Model
parts: how would I add variable "z" measured over the same three time points with the same covariates.

As long as the growth factors are labeled uniquely for each variable, all you need to do as add those specifications to the syntax.

#Latent
i.x =~ 1*x1 + 1*x2 + 1*x3
s.x =~ 1*x1 + 2*x2 + 3*x3
i.z =~ 1*z1 + 1*z2 + 1*z3
s.z =~ 1*z1 + 2*z2 + 3*z3

#Regression
i.x + i.z + s.x + s.z ~ age + education
Specifically, I would like to show the extent to which changes in x and z are correlated over time.

Those factor correlations should be estimated by default using the growth() function.

Terry
